capture_sources.name: HomeSwitch01
capture_sources.scope: Endpoint ingress and firewall-to-switch ingress; inter-switch links excluded

capture_sources.name: HomeSwitch02
capture_sources.scope: Endpoint, AP and R640 physical uplink ingress; inter-switch link excluded

capture_sources.name: HomeSwitch04
capture_sources.scope: Endpoint, office AP and all six K3s node ingress ports; uplink excluded

coverage_gaps: VM-to-VM traffic staying inside a hypervisor bridge needs virtual-switch or host capture.
Pod-to-pod traffic staying inside a K3s node needs node-level monitoring.
Traffic forwarded locally within an AP, wireless mesh, or downstream uninstrumented switch may bypass mirrored uplinks.
Only the recorded endpoint ports and selected VLANs are in scope; new ports or moved devices require inventory review.
Switch-originated traffic, WAN-only traffic and global IPv6 coverage are not fully validated.
TLS/QUIC payloads remain encrypted; metadata and fingerprints do not provide payload inspection.
